Figure 1.21 Image Description 
A plate which is divided into 4 parts. Half of the plate is Fruits and Vegetables (with the 
vegetables being a slightly larger segment). And the other half is grains and protein, with 
the grains being a slightly larger segment. Dairy is shown on the side in a small circle, 
representing a cup. 
MyPlate is a food guide to help Americans achieve the goals of the Dietary Guidelines for Americans. 
For most people this means eating MORE: 
• whole grains 
• fruits 
• vegetables (especially dark green vegetables and red and orange vegetables) 
• legumes 
• seafood (to replace some meals of meat and poultry) 
• low-fat dairy 
And LESS: 
• refined grains 
• added sugars 
• solid fats: saturated fats, trans fats, and cholesterol 
• sodium
